subject: ClearGate Systems penetration findings - prioritized remediation timeline & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@cleargate.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: pentest@securelabs.io
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ClearGate pentest report - evidence request & retest scope

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this. Attached is the ClearGate external penetration test report (external vendor: SecureLabs). The executive summary flags four medium/high findings that we need help closing before our customer pilot:

- AUTH-01: Inconsistent token invalidation on session revoke
- LOG-02: Missing structured audit events for service-to-service auth failures
- NET-03: Overly permissive egress to third-party analytics
- SECR-04: Stale credentials in automation pipelines (identified in CI logs)

Can you confirm the following, ideally by next Friday (2026-12-03):
1) Who at Redwood will own remediation, and their ETA per finding.
2) What evidence you can provide for each fix (config diffs, CI job run ids, log extracts, or screenshot of dashboards).
3) Any request for retest scope and whether a staging snapshot or temporary access is required.

Attached: cleargate_pentest_report_v1.pdf (PDF, 2.8MB)

We'd like to keep the retest scope limited to the four findings to accelerate closure. If you need more time, please propose a staggered delivery with the highest-risk items first.

Regards,
Patrick Lee
Security Program Manager, ClearGate Systems
patrick.lee@cleargate.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@cleargate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearGate pentest report - evidence request & retest scope

Patrick — thanks for the report and clear ask. We're assigning owners and will provide a prioritized ETA table. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Internal owners: Rishi (security lead) will own AUTH & SECR items; Irene (compliance) will coordinate LOG evidence and audit artifacts; Marissa (infra) will take NET changes.
- We will produce a remediation matrix with per-finding ETA, owner, evidence type and expected artifact names.
- For retest: we may need a short-lived staging token and a copy of the snapshot of the environment. Can you confirm whether SecureLabs will run the retest against staging credentials or if ClearGate prefers to schedule a limited window against production with traffic controls?

Proposed delivery cadence:
- 2026-11-30: initial remediation matrix + low-friction fixes (configuration changes, policy updates)
- 2026-12-06: evidence for AUTH-01 and LOG-02 (config diffs, log extracts)
- 2026-12-10: remediation for NET-03 and SECR-04 completed, artifact handoff

I'll attach the remediation matrix when Rishi populates it. 

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Sales Engineering (covering enterprise SOC requests)
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@cleargate.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearGate pentest report - evidence request & retest scope

Team / Patrick — I've attached a working remediation_matrix.xlsx and a short playbook for key items. Below is a concise owner/ETA/evidence plan per finding (plain language first, then artifacts).

AUTH-01 (Token invalidation):
- Owner: Rishi Malhotra
- Fix: Ensure revoke triggers cache invalidation and enforce token TTL at auth gateway; add a CI checkout that runs invalidate workflow.
- ETA: 2026-12-06 (code + infra change merged, deployment to staging 12/07)
- Evidence: PR link, deployment job id (jenkins job 1289), staged run showing denied token use (log snippet), screenshot of token invalidation dashboard.

LOG-02 (Structured audit events):
- Owner: Irene Choi
- Fix: Introduce structured audit events for service-to-service auth failures and add retention policy to observability backend.
- ETA: 2026-12-06 (schema + ingest pipeline change)
- Evidence: schema diff (audit_events_v2.json), ingest pipeline run id, kibana saved search link, sample log extracts (redacted)

NET-03 (Egress permissions):
- Owner: Marissa Cole
- Fix: Add explicit egress deny list, tighten VPC egress rules, and move analytics traffic to a vetted proxy.
- ETA: 2026-12-10 (policy rollout with canary)
- Evidence: VPC policy diff (terraform plan output), guardrail audit report, packet-capture sanitized sample, change request id SEC-7421

SECR-04 (Stale credentials):
- Owner: Rishi Malhotra (with infra)
- Fix: Rotate automation keys, add enforced vault policy and CI gate that blocks stale creds.
- ETA: 2026-12-10
- Evidence: kv_rotation_playbook.md, vault audit log extract, CI run id showing key rotation job.

Attachments in this message: remediation_matrix.xlsx (workbook with detailed rows), kv_rotation_playbook.md (markdown checklist).

Notes: For retest, SecureLabs/Patrick — a staging snapshot is preferred. We will issue STG credentials scoped to IP ranges and limited TTL (48h). Please confirm the target IP and preferred retest window; we suggest 2026-12-14 to allow for stabilization after policy rollouts.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Engineering
redwood_inference
From: Patrick Lee <patrick.lee@cleargate.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearGate pentest report - evidence request & retest scope

Monica / Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed matrix. A few clarifications before we lock the retest window: 

1) For AUTH-01, we'll need the exact token revocation log lines with timestamps and request ids so the retest can reproduce the invalidation sequence.
2) For LOG-02, sample log extracts need to include the schema field names (redacted values ok) so we can validate the event structure.
3) For NET-03, please include the Terraform plan output (sanitized) plus the canary rollout schedule so we can validate the enforcement periods.
4) For SECR-04, rotation evidence should include the vault audit UUIDs and the CI job run link that performed the change.

We confirm staging snapshot retest is acceptable. Target IP for SecureLabs: 54.172.11.9 (they will run from that address range). Preferred retest window: 2026-12-15 09:00-12:00 PST.

One small ask: please put the remediation_matrix.xlsx in a shared folder (Confluence or Google Drive) with view-only links for the SecureLabs team.

If you can deliver the artifacts listed in Rishi's ETA plan (by 2026-12-06 for AUTH & LOG), we'll schedule the retest for mid-December.

Thanks,
Patrick Lee
Security Program Manager, ClearGate Systems
